title: Correct v0 calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute v0 = 3 m/s using energy conservation for the combined system sliding down the incline.

title: Correct x1 calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute x1 = 0.125 m as the distance the board moves up after collision until relative rest.

title: Correct relative displacement x
description: Essential: Student must compute total relative displacement x = 1.5 m.

title: Post-collision accelerations
description: Important: Student must correctly set up Newton's second law for board (a1 = 11 m/s² up incline) and block (a2 = 1 m/s² down incline) after collision.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Student must analyze kinematics to find common velocity v = 2.5 m/s and displacements x1, x2 during relative motion phase.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Student must properly apply work-energy theorem to initial sliding phase with correct system mass.

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Pitfall: Student may confuse sign conventions for velocities/accelerations after collision reversal, leading to incorrect kinematic equations.

title: Friction direction error
description: Pitfall: Student may incorrectly assign friction direction on block or board after collision, reversing acceleration signs.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student demonstrates unit analysis throughout calculations, confirming dimensional consistency.
